Birdwatching observations and equipment: the user installed a backyard bird feeder and birdbath; House Sparrows, Mourning Doves, and Downy Woodpeckers visited the feeder, and a Blue Jay visited the birdbath for the first time on 2023-03-05. On 2023-03-10, the user and friend Sarah saw about 20 Canada Geese and a few Killdeer at a local park. The user was also planning a nature-reserve visit for 2023-02-25 through 2023-02-26 and a coastal birdwatching trip for 2023-04-01, and wanted to improve bird identification and carry a field guide.

Board games the user played or considered: around 2023-01-28, the user won a train-themed game against their roommate and played two rounds of Carcassonne with neighbors; on 2023-02-11, the user liked Azul’s tile-laying mechanics and planned to buy it to play with the neighbors at a future game night. The user also expressed interest in train-themed and tile-laying games similar to Ticket to Ride.

Art and antiques: at an art fair in Brooklyn in October 2022, the user attended with friend Emma and bought several works by emerging artists, including the painting Sunset by an unnamed up-and-coming artist whom the user met there. After moving to a new apartment, the user displayed Sunset in the living room and planned to catalog the collection. The user also inherited a 1930s Remington Noiseless Portable typewriter from their grandmother around late February (year unspecified), uses it to write letters, and recently bought an oak dresser from Henry’s antique shop.

The user’s short-film project had been in development for a few months by 2023-02-26, with production expected to begin soon. On 2023-02-26 the user was researching festivals, refining a drama with dark-humor elements, and considering changes to tone, pacing, and dialogue for a festival-friendly rewrite. The user hopes the film will someday be selected for the Sundance Film Festival. A few weeks before 2023-02-26, the user attended Sundance, saw The Whale and Women Talking, and met an old film-school friend working as a festival programmer. Elapsed development period: several months as of 2023-02-26; exact start date is unknown.

The user launched a graphic-design website and created a business-plan outline by 2023-02-10, then planned educational social-media content to establish expertise, especially in typography. On 2023-03-01, after signing a first freelance-client contract and attending a marketing workshop, the user chose a branding-project preparation checklist as a lead magnet, preferred Mailchimp for delivery, and planned a landing page with instant email automation. They intended to promote it through Facebook, Twitter, LinkedIn, and an email signature, with possible later guest blogging or paid advertising. The user’s indoor-plant care progressed from repotting a spider plant around 2023-02-08 to reporting on 2023-03-01 that it was doing much better and that the experience increased confidence in caring for another plant. The user considered adding a low-maintenance snake plant and a peace lily, particularly because they hoped a peace lily might help with stuffy apartment air, and asked whether it would tolerate a low-light room. On 2023-02-11, the user had also considered placing a snake plant on a bedroom nightstand and a peace lily on a shelf near a window. The interval from the spider-plant repotting to the follow-up was about three weeks.

The second method had been taught by the user’s mother. Total recorded sessions: 2.

The exact number of businesses or feedback attempts was not stated.
